title: CLUE: A Contrastive Learning Framework for Unsupervised Event Type Induction and Annotation
abstract: arXiv:2610.12580v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Event ontology is the foundational framework for defining events in a dataset. Event type induction generally involves domain experts who define guidelines for creating event types and their names based on the dataset's domain and scope. However, this process is resource-intensive in terms of annotation costs and is prone to human biases. To alleviate the need for manual event ontology creation, we propose the CLUE framework for event type induction, naming, and annotation. Our main contributions in this work are: 1) designing a novel joint embedding representation for expressing both the verb-centric view and the semantic view of events; 2) event type induction using contrastive loss guided clustering; 3) event naming and refinement. Experiments demonstrate the effectiveness of our method. Our code is available at https://github.com/PratikMaitra/CLUE.

translated_title: CLUE：一个用于无监督事件类型归纳与标注的对比学习框架
translated_abstract: 事件本体是定义数据集中事件的基础框架。事件类型归纳通常需要领域专家根据数据集的领域和范围制定准则来创建事件类型及其名称。然而，这一过程在标注成本方面非常耗费资源，且容易受到人为偏见的影响。为了减少人工创建事件本体的需求，我们提出了用于事件类型归纳、命名和标注的CLUE框架。我们在这项工作中的主要贡献包括：1）设计了一种新颖的联合嵌入表示，能够同时表达事件的以动词为中心的视角和语义视角；2）利用对比损失引导的聚类进行事件类型归纳；3）事件命名与细化。实验证明了我们方法的有效性。我们的代码已发布于 https://github.com/PratikMaitra/CLUE。
tldr: CLUE框架通过新颖的联合嵌入表示和对比损失引导的聚类，实现了无监督的事件类型归纳、命名与标注，从而降低了人工构建事件本体的成本和人为偏见。
en_tdlr: CLUE is a contrastive learning framework that achieves unsupervised event type induction, naming, and annotation through a novel joint embedding representation and contrastive loss-guided clustering, reducing the cost and human bias of manual event ontology construction.
